reviews.text: We have been bringing our pets to this clinic for three generations, and the head veterinarian explains things very accurately and clearly. He is a doctor we can entrust our pets to with complete confidence.

I took out an inexpensive pet insurance policy for my dog ​​shortly after birth to avoid any health problems.

He has sensitive skin, and the vet recommended skin medication, which he's been taking continuously. He's now 12 years old, and I heard this hospital near my home in Tokyo had a good reputation, so I brought him here for a second opinion. However, it was far from a second opinion.

They didn't even examine him thoroughly, which was very disappointing.

I submit a medical certificate to my insurance company every month, but perhaps because they've been prescribing medication for him for so long, previous hospitals never charged me for the certificate.

However, this animal hospital said they charge a fee for the medical certificate, just like for humans, which shocked and disappointed me.

I went there hoping for regular checkups, but I think it's unacceptable to be pressured into paying for something like that.

Humans and pets are different.

We had our dog spayed here.

They dressed her in a suit after the surgery, so we didn't need to buy an Elizabethan collar.

The head veterinarian was a kind-looking person who smiled a lot.

I think the doctor's approach to medicine is wonderful. I believe they provide extremely well-balanced care.

This is my third clinic (including one that has since closed), and the fees were comparable to the others.
I am filled with gratitude. Thank you so much to the doctors and nurses who are always there for the owners.
I'm always grateful for your socks.

The vet is kind and thorough, and performs detailed examinations.

However, the fees are by far the highest of any pet clinic I've been to. All the other hospitals I've been to have been kind, caring, and thorough, so I won't be going back here.

Excellent doctor, thorough care, clean.
The only drawback, if I had to find one, would be the lack of a dedicated parking lot.
